objective: Certificar operativamente la correccion R16 de Ventas Cerradas con evidencia SQL posterior a 2026-09-29T17:51:42Z. Confirmar ciclos automaticos INCR, unidades procesadas por run_id, FINISH del Scheduler y estado del lock. No modificar codigo ni datos. No tocar sync_comercial_abiertas_v2. Etiqueta: Sincronizador.

queries.name: post_r16_runs
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) run_id,MIN(run_timestamp) AS primero,MAX(run_timestamp) AS ultimo,COUNT(DISTINCT unidad_negocio_id) AS unidades,COUNT(*) AS logs,SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exitosos,SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_exitosos FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='INCREMENTAL' AND run_id LIKE 'INCR-%' AND run_timestamp>'2026-09-29T17:51:42' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY primero DESC

queries.name: latest_post_r16_units
queries.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT TOP (1) run_id FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='INCREMENTAL' AND run_id LIKE 'INCR-%' AND run_timestamp>'2026-09-29T17:51:42' ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC) SELECT s.run_id,u.codigo,u.nombre,s.run_timestamp,s.fecha_inicio,s.fecha_fin,s.status,s.source_connection_status,s.error_code,s.error_message FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 s JOIN latest l ON l.run_id=s.run_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u ON CONVERT(varchar(36),u.id)=CONVERT(varchar(36),s.unidad_negocio_id) ORDER BY s.run_timestamp

queries.name: scheduler_post_r16
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (30) JobName,RunID,Accion,FechaAccion,Exito,MensajeError,DetallesJSON FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND FechaAccion>'2026-09-29T17:51:42' ORDER BY FechaAccion DESC
